units.sourceHTML: 2 Reporting bugs ¶

units.text: To report bugs, suggest enhancements or otherwise discuss GNU ⟦0⟧, please send electronic mail to ⟦1⟧bug-time@gnu.org⟦2⟧.
units.sourceHTML: To report bugs, suggest enhancements or otherwise discuss GNU time, please send electronic mail to bug-time@gnu.org.

units.text: For bug reports, please include enough information for the maintainers to reproduce the problem. Generally speaking, that means:
units.sourceHTML: For bug reports, please include enough information for the maintainers to reproduce the problem. Generally speaking, that means:

units.text: The version numbers of GNU ⟦0⟧ (which you can find by running ‘⟦1⟧’⟦2⟧) and any other program(s) or manual(s) involved.
units.sourceHTML: • The version numbers of GNU time (which you can find by running ‘env time --version’) and any other program(s) or manual(s) involved.

units.text: Hardware and operating system names and versions.
units.sourceHTML: • Hardware and operating system names and versions.

units.text: The contents of any input files necessary to reproduce the bug.
units.sourceHTML: • The contents of any input files necessary to reproduce the bug.

units.text: A description of the problem and samples of any erroneous output.
units.sourceHTML: • A description of the problem and samples of any erroneous output.

units.text: Options you gave to ⟦0⟧ other than specifying installation directories.
units.sourceHTML: • Options you gave to configure other than specifying installation directories.

units.text: Anything else that you think would be helpful.
units.sourceHTML: • Anything else that you think would be helpful.

units.text: When in doubt whether something is needed or not, include it. It’s better to include too much than to leave out something important.
units.sourceHTML: When in doubt whether something is needed or not, include it. It’s better to include too much than to leave out something important.

units.text: Patches are welcome; if possible, please make them with ‘⟦0⟧’ and include ⟦1⟧ entries (see ⟦2⟧Change Log⟦3⟧ in ⟦4⟧The GNU Emacs Manual⟦5⟧). Please follow the existing coding style.
units.sourceHTML: Patches are welcome; if possible, please make them with ‘git format-patch’ and include ChangeLog entries (see Change Log in The GNU Emacs Manual). Please follow the existing coding style.

nonProse: Command/flag literals and code/output examples retained; headings, prose, explanatory dt/dd and table headings/cells extracted; complete adopted footnote included. Unreviewed candidate drafts only; no unhandled prose text.
